title: Survivalist
name: Tamsin
description: The Survivalist is a quiet, weathered woman who keeps to her camp at the Weald's edge and teaches the heroes what she can of living out there. She would rather go with them, but she is the Estate's way out: if the Caretaker falls, she alone can lead survivors down the Old Road or carry word beyond it. So she stays behind while the parties go in, and it pains her. When one doesn't come back, she goes into the Weald to look for them.
history: The Survivalist was born on a farm, long after her brothers. With no one to play with she spent her days in the woods, among fairies she imagined into the trees. At seven she wandered too far and was lost for five days, starving, while everyone she knew searched for her. When an Outrider at last found her, she found her calling. She joined the Union as soon as it would take her, and has spent her life on its trails. When the reports from the Estate grew too many to ignore, and even the coachmen refused to drive there, the Union stationed her at the Hamlet.
summary: A quiet Survivalist, an Outrider stationed at the Weald's edge, who teaches the heroes to survive out there and would rather go with them.

clothing.head: Tattered hood
clothing.body: Layered leathers under a fur mantle, a wolf's head at one shoulder
clothing.accessories: The Union's leaf brooch, pinned inside her hood

notes: Sometimes loses her train of thought mid-sentence and simply leaves it unfinished
Can make a decent stew out of anything
